title: Reserve Wizard: compact editor for GPU reserves and autoscale presets
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Operators managing Dedicated GPU reserves need a fast, low-friction way to configure reserve sizing, autoscale policies, and temporary surge settings without navigating multiple console pages. Current flows scatter capacity sizing, SLO-to-autoscale mappings, and burst configuration across three panels which increases mistakes and support tickets.

Goal: Deliver a compact ‘Reserve Wizard’ UX that guides operators through an SLO-aware reserve configuration in a single overlay: select SLO profile, set baseline reserve, attach autoscale policy, preview cost and latency tradeoffs, and stage a canary rollout. The editor should be usable for quick edits and safe for automation teams (copyable JSON, audit log entry).

Constraints: must align with existing console patterns (sidebar + modal flows), respect RBAC (read vs edit), show clear cost delta estimates, and support rollback/circuit-breaker toggles. Prototype must include keyboard accessibility and a condensed mobile/tablet layout for on-call usage in cramped viewports.
acceptance_criteria: Single overlay flow allows an operator to configure baseline reserve, attach one of three autoscale policies (conservative / balanced / aggressive), and save a named preset
In-overlay cost estimator shows delta compared to current reserve for 1h/24h/30d and updates interactively as sliders change
SLO profile selector maps to suggested autoscale thresholds and exposes a ‘tweak thresholds’ advanced section
Canary rollout panel supports selecting percentage, duration, and automatic rollback trigger (error rate or latency increase) and persists rollout in console rollouts list
Save action produces an audit-log entry, emits telemetry event (reserve.update) with preset id, and provides JSON export for automation
Prototype tested in 3 internal design reviews and validated with 4 platform engineers for feasibility
